Requirement: The system shall let a guest use Home, Search, Category Listing, Business Detail and Item Details without an account, open the sign-in prompt when a guest tries to add an item, order, book, save a location or open the Bookings tab, and bring the customer back to the blocked action after sign-in.

The system shall register a customer with first and last name, email, mobile number (+43 preselected), a password and the self-declaration "I am at least 14 years old", plus separate optional marketing consents that start unticked, and shall ask for nothing else at sign-up.
The system shall sign a customer in with email and password, with Google, or with Apple (offered on iOS only), and shall lock password sign-in for 15 minutes after 5 consecutive failed attempts.

The system shall let a customer reset a forgotten password with a 6-digit code sent by email, valid for 10 minutes and resendable after 60 seconds, and shall end every other session on the account when the new password is saved.

The system shall refuse a sign-up whose email address or mobile number already belongs to a customer account, or whose email address belongs to a Business Web Portal or Platform Admin account, and shall state which field conflicts.

The system shall let a customer edit first name, last name and mobile number, choose the app language (German or English) and switch push notifications for order and appointment updates on or off in Profile.

The system shall let a customer delete their account in the app after re-entering the password or re-authenticating with Google or Apple, refuse the request while an order is open or an appointment is upcoming, and erase or pseudonymize personal data within 30 days.

The system shall record every consent (terms version, privacy notice version, marketing email, marketing push, analytics) with timestamp, source and version, let the customer withdraw any optional consent in Profile, and start analytics collection only after opt-in.

The system shall let a Platform Admin produce a machine-readable export (JSON) of a customer's personal data, orders, appointments and consents for a verified access or portability request within 30 days.

The system shall show on Home, in order: a greeting with the customer's first name (signed in only), a location chip, a search bar, three category cards (Essen & Trinken, Haare & Beauty, Wellness & Massage), an Ongoing card for an order or appointment in progress (signed in only) and a Near you list of businesses ordered by distance.

The system shall search from the second character typed, update results as the customer types, match business name, business type, menu item name and service name, group results under Businesses, Dishes and Services, and open a dish or service result on its business page scrolled to that entry.

The system shall show a Category Listing with a horizontally scrolling row of business-type chips (for food: Alle, Restaurant, Café, Bäckerei), a "Jetzt geöffnet" filter, the number of results with a plain-language statement of the sort order, and the matching business cards.

The system shall render every business card with logo (or an initials tile), business name, business type, distance in kilometers with a decimal comma, the open state in words and a save control, and shall show no star ratings, review totals or sponsored markers.

The system shall show a Business Detail page with cover image, header (logo, name, type, open state with today's hours, distance, address that opens the maps app), a location selector for businesses with several locations, an About section with the business's legal information, sticky catalog category chips, and the menu or service list in the business's own order, using the business's brand color for headings and actions.

The system shall show each menu row with name, short description, VAT-inclusive price, optional image and the allergen letter codes, show sold-out items dimmed with the label "Ausverkauft" and without an add action, and never show items that are hidden from the app.

The system shall show an Item Details popup with image, name, VAT-inclusive price, description, ingredients where entered, allergens with letter code and name above the options (never collapsed), an information control listing all 14 allergens, option groups with required flag, price change and allergen letters per choice, a note field, a quantity stepper and an Add button labeled with the running total.
The system shall let a signed-in customer save and unsave a business location from any business card or business page and list saved locations in Profile.

The system shall let a customer choose allergens to avoid and mark, on every menu, items that contain them and items whose choices may add them, keeping the selection on the device only and never presenting an item as safe.

The system shall keep one cart per customer for one business location, ask before replacing it when an item from another location is added, show a cart bar with item count and running total on the business page, let the customer change quantity, edit a configured line or remove it, and discard a cart after 24 hours without activity.
API operations: Cart held on the device; sent with quoteCheckout and placeOrder

Requirement: The system shall offer 15-minute pickup slots computed from the location's ordering hours, the preparation lead time, the pause state and the remaining slot capacity, and show the earliest slot first.

The system shall hold one unit of capacity in the chosen pickup slot for 10 minutes, show the remaining hold time at checkout, and release the hold when the order is placed, the slot is changed, checkout is left or the hold expires.

The system shall show a checkout summary with lines, choices and notes, the pickup slot, a voucher field, the payment method, subtotal, discount, total including VAT and the VAT contained per rate, the business's identity, and an order button labeled "Zahlungspflichtig bestellen".
The system shall create an order in status Placed with a 4-character pickup code, show it on the location's order board, and confirm it to the customer in the app and by email.

The system shall show the customer a live status timeline (Placed, Accepted, Preparing, Ready, Completed, or the terminal status reached) and send a push notification on Accepted, Ready, Rejected, delay and Canceled by the business; only the business or a system timeout changes a status.

The system shall auto-reject an order that the business has not accepted within 5 minutes of placement (for a pre-order placed while the location is closed, within 30 minutes of the next opening), void its payment authorization and tell the customer.

The system shall show Cancel order only while cancellation is allowed, state in the confirmation dialog how the money is returned, and cancel the order, release the slot and void or refund the payment on confirmation.

The system shall list the customer's orders and appointments under Upcoming (soonest first) and Past (most recent first) with business, status in words, one-line summary, date and time and total, and show Booking Details with status timeline, pickup code, lines, payment summary with VAT per rate and the available actions.

The system shall rebook a completed or canceled order by copying its items, choices and quantities into a fresh cart at the same location, priced from the current menu, and list any item that is no longer available.

The system shall let a customer pre-order items that carry a lead time (for example whole cakes, 48 hours) for a pickup slot at least that lead time and at most 7 days ahead, using the largest lead time in the cart.

The system shall re-check slot capacity, item availability, prices and allergen declaration versions when payment authorization succeeds, require the customer to review and confirm any line whose allergens or price changed after it was added, and offer the next 3 free slots when the chosen slot filled while the bank confirmed the payment.

The system shall take in-app payments by Visa or Mastercard and by Apple Pay or Google Pay through the card payment provider's hosted components, with strong customer authentication by 3-D Secure 2, without card data reaching the platform systems.
The system shall authorize the payment when the order is placed, capture it when the business accepts, and void it when the order is rejected, auto-rejected or canceled before acceptance.

The system shall offer "Bezahlung bei Abholung" (pay at pickup) where the business enables it, mark such orders as due at the business, and require staff to confirm payment at the counter before completing them.

The system shall let a Business Admin refund a captured order in full or in part with a reason, refund automatically when a customer cancels an accepted order within the cutoff, and never refund more than the captured amount.

The system shall compute order totals from VAT-inclusive prices, allocate discounts to VAT-rate groups and compute the VAT contained per rate as defined in BR-035, identically in the quote, the order, the receipt and refunds.

The system shall validate a voucher code at checkout (exists, active, within validity, redemptions left, minimum order value reached, valid for the business), allow one code per order, and show its effect before the order is placed.
The system shall issue an itemized receipt in the business's name after capture, email it and show it in Booking Details, and refuse in-app payment for orders above EUR 400.00 gross.

The system shall deduct the platform's commission at capture, have the card payment provider pay out the balance to the business weekly, and show the Business Admin payout statements and a monthly commission invoice.

The system shall verify the signature of every card payment provider webhook, process each event ID exactly once, and reconcile payment state hourly against the provider for orders older than 15 minutes in a non-final state.
The system shall list a salon's or spa's bookable services with name, duration, VAT-inclusive price (or a price-from), description and the staff who perform them.

The system shall let the customer choose a staff member or "Beliebig" (any available) and show, per day for the booking horizon, only the start times at which the whole service and its buffer fit the staff member's day.
The system shall hold the selected start time for 10 minutes with a visible countdown and release it on expiry, on a different choice or when the customer leaves the booking.

The system shall confirm an appointment only after re-validating the staff member's time in the database, assign a staff member for "Beliebig", and send a confirmation in the app and by email with a calendar file.
The system shall send an appointment reminder 24 hours before the start by email, and by push where enabled, with links to reschedule or cancel while that is still allowed.
The system shall let the customer cancel or reschedule an appointment in the app until the business's free-cancellation cutoff, and after the cutoff show the business's phone number instead.
The system shall manage appointment status Confirmed, Checked in, Completed, Canceled and No-show, and show the current status in words to the customer.
The system shall let the customer add a note of up to 300 characters to an appointment and show it to the business in the day view.

The system shall show the service price and "Bezahlung vor Ort" (paid at the venue) before confirmation, label the confirm button "Zahlungspflichtig buchen", and take no payment in the app for appointments.
The system shall require a reason when the business cancels an appointment and notify the customer immediately with a link to book again.

The system shall let a Business Admin maintain the business profile: display name, description, logo, cover, gallery, brand color (accepted only with at least 4.5:1 contrast against white) and the legal information shown on the business page.

The system shall let a Business Admin maintain each location: geocoded address, phone, weekly opening and ordering hours with several intervals per day, dated closures, slot capacity, preparation lead time, order cancellation cutoff and whether pay at pickup is offered.

The system shall let a Business Admin maintain menu categories and items with name (German, optional English), description, VAT-inclusive price, tax category, image, ingredients, visibility in the app, pre-order lead time, sort order and per-location availability.

The system shall require a complete allergen declaration for every food item and option choice before it can be published, record each change as a new declaration version confirmed by a Business Admin, and make the confirmed version live for customers within 60 seconds.

The system shall let a Business Admin define option groups (name, required or optional, minimum and maximum choices) with choices that carry a VAT-inclusive price change and their own allergen declaration.

The system shall let a Business Admin maintain services with duration (15 to 480 minutes in 5-minute steps), buffer after (0 to 60 minutes), price or price-from, tax category, qualified staff and whether the service can be booked online.
The system shall let a Business Admin invite users by email with the role Business Admin or Staff, mark staff as bookable, and deactivate a user, which ends that user's sessions immediately.

The system shall let a Business Admin maintain weekly working hours, breaks and absences for bookable staff, and refuse to save a change that overlaps confirmed appointments until each one is reassigned or canceled with a reason.
The system shall let a Business Admin create business-funded voucher codes with fixed or percentage value, minimum order value, validity window and redemption limits.

The system shall show a live order board per location with columns New, In preparation and Ready, alert audibly and visually on each new order until it is accepted or rejected, and show the countdown to auto-rejection.
The system shall let staff accept an order or reject it with a reason, capture the payment on acceptance and void it on rejection.
The system shall let staff move an order to Preparing and Ready, delay an accepted order by 10, 15 or 30 minutes with a customer notification, and complete it only after the pickup code is matched.
The system shall let staff mark an item sold out for a location until the end of the day or until reset, and mark it available again.
The system shall let staff pause new orders for a location for 15, 30 or 60 minutes or until resumed.
The system shall show today's appointments per bookable staff member and let staff check a customer in, complete an appointment, mark a no-show or cancel with a reason.
The system shall limit the Staff role to the POS view and deny catalog, price, allergen, staff, refund, statement and settings functions in the user interface and in the API.
API operations: Enforced on every Business operation (403 for Staff)

Requirement: The system shall let staff mark a Ready order Not collected from 60 minutes after the end of its pickup slot.
The system shall show on each order ticket the lines with their choices, the allergens of each configured line, the customer's note, the customer's first name and the pickup slot.

The system shall accept a business application through a public web form (applicant, legal data, category and business types, first location, contact) after the applicant verifies their email address.

The system shall give Platform Admins a verification queue in which they check the register numbers, confirm the UID number through the EU VAT number validation service, request more information, and approve or reject an application with a reason.
The system shall start the card payment provider's hosted onboarding (identity and bank account checks) for an approved food business and keep its status current from provider webhooks.
The system shall show the business a go-live checklist and let a Platform Admin publish the business only when every go-live condition is met.

The system shall let a Platform Admin suspend or reinstate a business with a statement of reasons sent to the Business Admin, remove a suspended business from discovery at once and let its open orders run to completion.
The system shall let a Platform Admin maintain tax categories and their VAT rates as effective-dated reference data, applied by order date without a software release.
The system shall keep an append-only audit trail of allergen declarations, price changes, refunds, verification decisions, role changes and suspensions, searchable by business, actor and date.
The system shall let a customer send private feedback (score 1 to 5 and optional text) on a completed order or appointment, visible only to Platform Admins and never shown publicly.
The system shall let a Platform Admin create platform-funded voucher codes (for example a welcome voucher) with the same parameters as business vouchers.
Customer API read operations respond quickly under lunch-peak load. Target: p95 at or below 300 ms and p99 at or below 800 ms at 150 requests per second
Home shows the Near you list quickly on a mid-range Android phone. Target: Cold start to first business card at or below 3.0 s p90 on a reference device over a 10 Mbit/s connection
Availability for one service, one day and all qualified staff is computed quickly. Target: p95 at or below 400 ms for a location with 8 staff and 60 appointments that day
New orders reach the order board quickly. Target: p95 at or below 3 s from placement to ticket shown; p99 at or below 6 s

The platform carries the Vienna launch volume with headroom. Target: 1,500 Live locations, 60,000 monthly active customers, 900 orders per 15-minute lunch window and 1,200 concurrent order board connections
Ordering, booking and the order board are available. Target: 99.5% monthly between 06:00 and 23:00 Europe/Vienna, excluding announced maintenance outside 06:00-23:00
Data can be restored after a failure. Target: RPO 15 minutes, RTO 4 hours; restore rehearsed quarterly
The order board keeps working when the live connection drops. Target: Falls back to polling every 15 s within 10 s of disconnect and shows "Live-Verbindung unterbrochen"; no order lost
The application is free of serious known weaknesses at each release. Target: OWASP ASVS 4.0.3 Level 2 controls in scope; no open Critical or High finding from the release penetration test
Card data never reaches the platform systems. Target: Payment entry only through the provider's hosted fields or wallet sheets; PCI DSS self-assessment SAQ A scope
Credentials and sessions are protected. Target: Passwords hashed with Argon2id; access tokens 15 minutes; refresh tokens 30 days, rotated on use and revoked on password change
Portal accounts use a second factor. Target: TOTP second factor mandatory for Business Admin and Platform Admin; optional for Staff on shared POS tablets with a 12-hour session
Business data is isolated per business. Target: Every business-scoped table carries business_id, enforced by PostgreSQL row-level security; cross-business access attempts return 404 and are logged
Personal data is minimized and stays in the EU. Target: Sign-up collects only the BR-002 fields; all processing and storage in EU regions; every processor under a GDPR Article 28 agreement
Data subject requests are met on time. Target: Erasure within 30 days (BR-005); access export within 30 days (FR-ACC-09); request log kept
Discovery is fast. Target: At most 2 taps from app launch to any business page
Every validation message states the problem and the fix in the user's language. Target: German (de-AT) and English text for every message; no raw codes shown

Apps are usable with assistive technology. Target: WCAG 2.2 AA for the web portals; the customer app supports 200% text size, screen readers and 44 x 44 pt targets; open state, status and allergens never rely on color alone

The product is German-first. Target: de-AT default, English selectable; dates DD.MM.YYYY, times HH:mm 24-hour, amounts "€ 1.234,56", distances "2,4 km"; the customer app uses "du", the portals use "Sie"

Supported platforms. Target: iOS 16 or later; Android 9 (API 28) or later; current and previous major versions of Chrome, Edge, Firefox and Safari; the POS view on tablets 10 inches or larger in landscape
The customer app is light and stable. Target: Download size at or below 40 MB; crash-free sessions at or above 99.5% over 7 days

Time is handled consistently. Target: Timestamps stored in UTC and shown in Europe/Vienna; slot and availability grids remain correct on daylight-saving change days (no duplicated or missing 15-minute slot)

Allergen, price and availability data shown to customers is fresh. Target: A confirmed change is visible in every customer channel within 60 s; menu responses are never cached for more than 60 s by any shared cache
Business rules are protected by automated tests. Target: Every BR has at least one automated test that fails when the rule is broken; CI blocks a merge that lowers rule coverage
Regulated values change without a release. Target: VAT rates, slot defaults, cancellation cutoffs and notice periods are configuration or effective-dated reference data
Errors are visible without leaking personal data. Target: All apps report to error monitoring with release and device context; personal data and allergen selections are scrubbed before sending

Business anomalies alert on-call staff. Target: Alerts on: any slot over capacity; 3-D Secure challenge duration p90 above 5 minutes; slot holds expiring during payment above 5% in 15 minutes; menu cache age above 60 s; order board disconnected while ordering is open
